title: Stop folding consecutive Read/Search results into one summary line
description: The transcript replaces runs of read and search calls with a single collapsed entry. This passes the individual messages through instead. Brief mode keeps its own collapse pipeline, which is left alone.

sites.description: The function building {type:"collapsed_read_search"}. Several exist; only the accumulator reads <param>.messages[0], and that is the whole test. Arity is deliberately not part of it — the standalone script pinned params.length to 1 and by 2.1.280 the accumulator takes (e,n), so it would find nothing. Reading the first parameter's messages array is what the function *is*; how many arguments it happens to take is not.

<arr>.push(<creator>(<state>)) — the fold itself. Rewritten to push each message instead. forEach rather than spread because Function.prototype.apply caps its argument count and transcripts get long; it stays a single expression so it remains valid inside the comma-sequence forming the flush body.
